summary: The paper analyzes annotator comments on AI-generated image safety to understand qualitative moral, emotional, and contextual reasoning behind harm judgments, and argues for improved evaluation designs.

practices.reason: Findings suggest current safety annotation pipelines miss forms of harm reasoning, pointing to improvements in eval/annotation design though no concrete transferable method is given.
practices.quote: We argue for evaluation designs that scaffold moral reflection, differentiate types of harm, and make space for subjective, context-sensitive interpretations of AI-generated content.
